Material Design Lite

Google’s 2015 library of Material components in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, for websites that did not use a framework.

Source
GitHub: google/material-design-lite
Creator
Google
Made
2015 (repository created 14 January 2015)
Style
Material Design (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Orderly, systematic
Evidence
Opened the template previews dashboard_2x.jpg and general_2x.jpg (1786 × 966 each) from the repository’s docs/_assets/templates folder on 28 September 2026. Not stored. getmdl.io returned HTTP 403 to scripts.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The README describes MDL as “an implementation of Material Design components in vanilla CSS, JS, and HTML” and says that it is now in limited support, with development moved to Material Components for the web. It also says that the old getmdl.io documentation site is gone. README.

The GitHub API gives the license as Apache 2.0 and the creation date as 14 January 2015.

Observed

  • Dashboard template: a dark blue-gray navigation drawer with a round avatar, white Roboto labels, and a cyan band that marks the selected item.
  • The content area is pale gray with a white header bar and a white card that has a soft shadow and square corners. The card holds two flat ring charts in lime green and cyan.
  • General template: a full-bleed photo above a blue-gray tab bar with all-capital labels, where a pink underline marks the active tab.

Why it belongs

The templates show how the style moved from phones to the web: the drawer and app bar stay, and the card becomes the main unit of a desktop layout.

Borrow

Mark the active tab with a 2 px accent underline, and keep the tab labels in medium all-capital letters on the primary color.
